featured_reviews.name: Sanya Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text: I always knew how investing helps people, but was very scared to start because I did not know the steps required to do this. I found Basic Financial’s page on Instagram and I messaged them. They reached out to me super quickly, and explained the process to me in depth. I feel more confident than I did 2 years ago, and that also with relatively good gains in my portfolio. I would recommend everyone to reach out to them if you need someone to handle your portfolio, especially if you are very busy in life, like me. Keep up the good work.
